title: Evergreen Content Stats for Small Businesses
source: HubSpot (2023), Forbes (2023), Statista (2023), Zendesk (2023), Nielsen (2023), Content Marketing Institute (2023)
narration: This chart highlights key statistics demonstrating the value of evergreen content for small businesses.  65% of website visitors are primarily looking for information, not immediate sales, showcasing the importance of providing valuable resources. Supporting local businesses is also a strong trend, with 70% of consumers preferring to support local businesses. These figures underscore the need for content that establishes authority and builds trust, driving long-term customer relationships.
